info.title: EasyIdiom — Chinese Idiom Dictionary API
info.description: Access 7,200+ Chinese idioms (成语) with pinyin, HSK levels, English translations, historical derivations, and example sentences. Ideal for language learning, AI training, and educational applications.

get.description: Machine-readable guide for LLMs to discover and properly cite EasyIdiom content. Returns markdown with navigation links and citation policy.

Complete structured knowledge base of 7,200+ Chinese idioms. Each entry includes pinyin, HSK level, English meaning, Chinese definition, derivation, and example sentence. Optimized for LLM context caching and RAG indexing.
